method: Inspect the live top ten from Overture, Nominatim, and Photon for each name and name-plus-locality query.
Validate entity identity and accepted names against government or intergovernmental sources that were not derived from a compared provider.
Change only the benchmark contract, then rerun the unchanged live service and all three providers.

sources.claim: UK Parliament treats Big Ben as the globally famous Westminster landmark and documents its relationship to Elizabeth Tower.
The official Grade I Palace of Westminster entry includes Elizabeth Tower, home of the famous bell Big Ben, and supplies the statutory location.

name_only.overture: Only Big Ben Memorial Statue in Ontario; the London target is absent.
name_only.nominatim: Top ten are geographic and other homonyms outside London; the London target is absent.
name_only.photon: Top ten are geographic and other homonyms outside London; the London target is absent.

name_locality.overture: A same-named London POI 1.337 km from gold was formerly credited at rank 1; the actual Westminster landmark is rank 3 and 0.002 km from gold.
name_locality.nominatim: The Westminster landmark is rank 1 and 0.002 km from gold.
name_locality.photon: The Westminster landmark is rank 1 and 0.002 km from gold.

contract_after.reason: A tower-specific point contract should not credit a different same-named POI 1.337 km away; 0.25 km remains generous for point placement around the official structure.

classification.entity_contract: valid after tightening the spatial guard

sources.claim: Peru's Ministry of Culture calls the archaeological target the Ciudadela Inka (Llaqta) de Machupicchu.
Peru's Ministry of Culture uses ciudadela de Machu Picchu and Santuario Historico de Machu Picchu for the archaeological target.
UNESCO's official property name is Historic Sanctuary of Machu Picchu and its description identifies the archaeological citadel at the property's heart.

live_evidence.overture_name_only: The exact-name rank-1 point is 2.291 km away near Machupicchu Pueblo and remains rejected; Ciudadela De Machu Picchu is rank 10 and 0.355 km from gold.
live_evidence.overture_name_locality: Machu Picchu Cusco still misses; its top result is a museum in Cusco city, 72.958 km from gold.
live_evidence.nominatim: Ciudadela de Machu Picchu is rank 1 and 0.138 km from gold for both query styles.
live_evidence.photon: The name-only target is rank 2 and 0.052 km from gold; the official citadel name becomes rank 1 and 0.138 km from gold for the locality query.

contract_after.reason: The old contract falsely rejected official Spanish and UNESCO names while correctly rejecting the town-side exact-name point.

classification.name_only_overture: retrieved at rank 10; not a producer-admission miss
classification.name_locality_overture: separate region-context/routing miss, not evidence for producer admission

overture.interpretation: Rank 1 falls only because the Big Ben homonym is no longer a false positive; rank 10 gains the official Machu Picchu citadel.

next_gate: Design bounded producer admission for the confirmed Big Ben, Empire State Building, and Brandenburg Gate name-only misses. Keep Machu Picchu Cusco in the separate region-context routing backlog.
